final_answer:
The probability that all three marbles drawn are different colors is calculated by dividing the number of favorable outcomes by the total number of outcomes. The total number of ways to choose 3 marbles out of 10 is $ \binom{10}{3} $. The number of favorable outcomes (one red, one blue, and one green) is $ \binom{5}{1} \times \binom{3}{1} \times \binom{2}{1} $. Therefore, the probability is $ \frac{\binom{5}{1} \times \binom{3}{1} \times \binom{2}{1}}{\binom{10}{3}} $.

This is my analysis.
